profile: Mac Companion local XPC Interactive lease transport v0.1
rules: exact session and primary termination fences pending installs before serialized cleanup; late preparation cannot issue a lease, an already-sent install requires four-effect revocation, and a late lease lookup cannot start renewal
same-team exact-role authentication and menu readiness are required before Interactive lease traffic
the permanent Agent runtime receives only the one cached opaque sender endpoint issued for an exact authenticated-and-ready menu generation

every request rechecks the exact listener run, retained peer, transport generation, and private endpoint token on the server queue; a stale endpoint never redirects traffic to a replacement generation

the Agent sender and menu receiver share exactly one cross-family command in flight for all nine Desktop, lease-lifecycle, inventory, resolution, surface-transition, acknowledgement, and failure-convergence commands per authenticated generation
requests and payload-bearing success values are nonempty canonical JSON data no larger than 4096 bytes, except the surface inventory success value which is bounded to 65536 bytes

install carries the complete current prepared Desktop descriptor and its lease binds the exact session, epoch, surface, revisions, and interaction classes before any platform effect

the menu samples its local monotonic clock, resolves the opaque display only inside the menu process, and returns no physical display identifier, display name, process identifier, window identifier, permission fact, or platform object

surface inventory returns the complete privacy-filtered snapshot of at most 192 application or window candidates without silently truncating it; an inventory whose canonical reply exceeds 65536 bytes fails closed; selection tokens are session-scoped and disclose no title, bundle identifier, process identifier, or platform object
surface inventory expires after at most 120000 monotonic milliseconds; refresh replaces tokens and selection rechecks live source ownership, availability, exclusion policy, and capture authority

install and revoke receipts are validated against the exact retained command before success
renewal success is the exact payload-free acknowledgement to its one retained request
the receiver revalidates current monotonic time and runtime authority inside the serialized runtime owner
the receiver completes within four monotonic seconds and the sender waits at most five

there is no handled application-error envelope; rejection, timeout, cancellation after send, malformed traffic, unknown fields, cross-kind replies, premature traffic, and concurrent admission terminate the generation
generation loss invokes menu-runtime authority invalidation and the Agent treats every ambiguous result as Control teardown
runtime lifecycle traffic contains no media, input, screen pixels, focus, route, credential, private key, or arbitrary diagnostic text
